title: Stripe U2/U3, Connect, Global Payouts, African PSP access, and the PaySwap node network

source.operator_order: 2026-11-03 conversation: evaluate PaymentIntent and Payment Link as economic transfers; discover valid multi-provider/multi-node routes; enable Africa-facing Stripe/Paystack pathways; configure U2/U3, Stripe Connect, Global Payouts, and remaining Stripe operations.
source.prior_wave: P26 CLOSED at main base 5ca077e1b3e3c25897b605e683a4e7da27277cb1; see spec/dependency/P26-DEPENDENCY-GRAPH.json and docs/productization-evidence/P26-ACCEPTANCE-RECORD-2026-11-03.md.

policy: PROPOSAL ONLY. Resident-TL must re-verify every requirement against source, current provider documentation, actual operator-account entitlements, tests and CI; accept the architecture ADR and graph before implementation. No live-mode activation, unapproved P2P, disguised merchant payment links, bypass through multiple nodes, or credential handling outside the host-side secret broker.

lane_scope: Source-verify P26 base, current U1/U2/U3, Stripe catalogue 634/644 state, Connect, account-link/session REAUTH gates, Stripe Global Payouts entitlement/API, Paystack transfers, Flutterwave/MTN MoMo, route-compiler and multi-node execution seams.
Reconcile stale P26-A/B/C/D PENDING labels in spec/dependency/work-orders.md against P26-DEPENDENCY-GRAPH.json and P26-ACCEPTANCE-RECORD-2026-11-03.md.

Produce accepted ADR-0020 (or next verified available ADR number), current country/product capability matrix, purpose/regulatory eligibility table, exact operator prerequisites, dependency graph and lane ownership.
Separate PaymentIntent/Payment Link economic value transfer from provider product and regulated activity classification; Global Payouts P2P must be separately entitled and licensed.
Define node enrolment/attestation, provider-evidenced capability offers, bounded multi-hop graph search, per-leg custody/funding/authorization/reconciliation, privacy and no-bypass controls.

Stripe U2 delegated OAuth and U3 Connect platform/connected-account setup using current Stripe APIs, system-browser auth, host-side secrets, verified account identity, hosted onboarding, capability requirements, webhooks, account context, actions and reconciliation.
Stripe Connect charge/transfer/payout models with platform, seller, merchant-of-record, refund/dispute and liability semantics explicitly reviewed.
Sandbox end-to-end tests; LIVE remains refused under INV-25.
Dedicated Stripe Global Payouts product and entitlement slice; do not alias ordinary Stripe payouts or Connect transfers.
Treasury/financial-account prerequisites, recipient creation and hosted forms, third-party payout execution, country/method/amount/FX/fee eligibility, events, status retrieval and reconciliation.
Fail closed unless eligible origin country, product entitlement, funding and required licences/Stripe approvals are proven.

Paystack Africa connection and local collection/recipient/payout vertical slices: Ghana bank and mobile-money, Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa where account entitlements and current country/method documentation confirm support.
Hosted onboarding/payment links, recipient validation, transfer OTP/finalize, webhook verification, transfer read-back, idempotency and reconciliation.
Re-audit Flutterwave and MTN MoMo; implement only capability slices with real valid credentials and provider evidence.
Multi-node identity/enrolment, signed and expiring capability offers bound to accountable legal principals and real provider connected instances.
Bounded graph search over typed provider-operation edges; compare direct/native, composed and multi-node paths after hard policy/country/method/funding gates.
Multi-leg saga orchestration with one immutable route digest and separate per-leg authorization, idempotency, evidence and reconciliation; privacy minimization, revocation, retries and compensation.
Merged-tree integration, exact-package tests, typecheck, architecture, lint, CI, route and desktop/web integration journeys.
Real Sandbox evidence where credentials and product entitlements are supplied; no fixture promotion and no live activation.
Update FEATURE-MAP, JOURNEY-MAP, current-state, acceptance record, work-orders catalog and evidence bundle; record all operator-gated and product-preview limitations.

closure_policy: P27 cannot close on operation counts or synthetic route compilation alone. Each enabled journey must have current product/country eligibility, account entitlement and provider-evidenced capabilities; real Sandbox end-to-end state change/read-back where available; no secret leakage; per-leg approvals and reconciliation; and honest exclusions for every unsupported or operator-gated corridor. Any LIVE launch requires a separate operator order, completion of ADR-0019 activation prerequisites and independent live certification.
wave_status: PROPOSED — proposal branch and handoff created; resident-TL/operator acceptance required. No Stripe platform, Connect or Global Payouts account has been configured by this registration.
